description: This PHP script handles the upload process for attachments in the TestLink project. It manages file uploads, registers attachments in the database, and ensures proper permissions, supporting multiple file uploads via HTML5. The script initializes parameters, processes uploaded files, creates attachment records, and displays the upload interface.

classes.name: tlAttachmentRepository
classes.description: A class responsible for managing attachment records in the database, specifically inserting new attachments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of tlAttachmentRepository with a database connection.

methods.name: insertAttachment
methods.description: Inserts a new attachment record into the database.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class used to handle Smarty templating engine for rendering the upload UI.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments required for the upload page (attachment ID, target table, optional title).

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the attachment upload page based on configuration.
